duration: Per shift; length not stated on the page
name: Youth Volunteering at Second Harvest Foodbank
org: Second Harvest Foodbank of Southern Wisconsin
what_you_do: Youth volunteers sort and repack food in the warehouse during Food Sort/Repack shifts.
who_can_apply: Ages 12 to 17. Ages 12 to 15 must have an adult chaperone (21 or older) for the whole shift. Ages 16 and 17 can volunteer without a chaperone.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for a shift.
how_to_apply: Register in the Second Harvest volunteer portal and sign up for a Food Sort/Repack shift. Bring a youth waiver signed by a parent or guardian to each shift. Questions: volunteers@secondharvestsw.org or 608-216-7214.
notes: The site blocked automated reading of the youth page on Nov 4, 2026, so confirm first. The main volunteer page still shows the age 12 start and the adult rule for ages 12 to 15. Groups with youth should add (YOUTH) to the group name when signing up.
